hooks.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p='C:\Cynosure\@TASKS.md'; if(Test-Path $p) { $r=Get-Content $p -Raw; $m=[regex]::Matches($r, '### Task \d+ \(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\)\s+(.+?)(?=###|\Z)', [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline) | Select-Object -Last 4 | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value.Trim() }; $msg='**Last 4 Completed Tasks:**

' + ($m -join '

'); @{systemMessage=$msg} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } else { @{systemMessage='Task file not found at @TASKS.md'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }"
